subsystem.name: CollisionGlobals
subsystem.responsibility: Family of 44 one-shot collision-subsystem global data-block initializers. Every member writes a leading tag literal into a fixed global address, zeroes the following parameter dwords (four to five), optionally writes a tail threshold literal (9000/18000/27000), and returns 0; several also delegate to unnamed callees named only in raw source.

summary: 44 one-shot collision-globals initializers (0x0044CF20..0x0044E5A0), all straight-line writes of a leading tag literal plus zeroed parameter dwords (optionally a tail threshold), no guards, no this-pointer, no callers. Proposed as a single DERIVED class CollisionGlobalsInitializer; tag semantics, tail-threshold meaning, block-contiguity, and the four unnamed callees are unresolved.

classes.name: CollisionGlobalsInitializer
classes.responsibility: DERIVED grouping of the structurally identical straight-line global-block initializers. The packet gives no this-pointer, no static callers, and no frame-path membership, so class ownership is a reconstruction grouping, not an evidenced C++ class. ABI names partition the functions into grid/state/region/table/broadphase/config/audio/global prose families; those partitions are unverified. Distinct global blocks are initialized by distinct functions; contiguity between blocks does not prove shared struct ownership.

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionGlobalsInitValues
compatibility_contracts.description: 44 fixed global data blocks are written once with a leading type/tag literal and zeroed parameter dwords (some with a tail threshold 9000/18000/27000) by the initializers at 0x0044CF20..0x0044E5A0. A replacement executable that wants identical startup state must initialize these globals with the same values, or reimplement the behaviour that reads them.

unresolved: Class ownership: every function has owner trust UNKNOWN, no this-pointer, no static callers, and is not on a tick frame path; CollisionGlobalsInitializer is a DERIVED grouping of structurally identical initializers, not evidenced original-source structure.

Unnamed callees GlobalStateInitializer_cf34 (0x0044CF20), AudioMixerGainInit (0x0044CF80), InitFloatGlobals_d054 (0x0044D040), and InitRenderConstantsZeroOne (0x0044D2E0) have no addresses or prototypes in the packet; the call targets are unlinked.

Semantic meaning of the tag literals (13, 16, 17, 18, 20-24, 27, 28, 38, 39, 41-44, 46, 48-51, 53-57, 62, 63, 69-74, 77-79, 81, 82, 106-109) is not established; the grid/state/region/table/broadphase/config prose names are DERIVED and unverified, and 0x0044DDC0's 'SteeringSensitivity' label conflicts with the table-entry reading.
Literals 1065353216 (plausibly 1.0f) and -1082130432 (plausibly -1.0f) are stored in dwords; the float-vs-integer intent is ambiguous from the raw source (float reading DERIVED).

Tail thresholds 9000 (0x0044E180, 0x0044E480), 18000 (0x0044E1E0), and 27000 (0x0044E240, 0x0044E3C0, 0x0044E540) have no evidenced meaning; the toe-angle/renderer-threshold/caster-limit/max-distance/UI-stat prose readings conflict and are all DERIVED.

Adjacent global blocks (e.g. 0x007CCC08/0x007CCC20/0x007CCC98/0x007CCCC0) are written by separate initializer functions; equal 4-byte spacing suggests array/struct strides but no packet evidence shows a loop, shared base pointer, or common owner, so equality of ownership is unproven.

Field-level layout (tag at +0x0, zeroed parameters at +0x4..+0x14) is recorded in role prose and the compatibility contract; the architecture schema's field mechanism requires field: evidence refs that this packet does not allow, so classes carry empty fields arrays.
